|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Bow To The First Order (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-D-Bow_To_The_First_Order-2021-12-21-errata-slip.png]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V4-D-Bow_To_The_First_Order-2021-12-21-errata-slip-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V4-D-Bow_To_The_First_Order-original-2018-07-08-022435b.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V4-D-Bow_To_The_First_Order-2021-12-21-errata-slip-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V4-D-Bow_To_The_First_Order-2021-12-21-errata-slip.png]], 21 December 2021).
* '''Original''' ([[Bow To The First Order]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-bowtothefirstorder022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/bowtothefirstorder.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Dark/large/bowtothefirstorder.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Debris Zone”. Text: “Deploy on table. Once per game, may take Finalizer into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per character, when you deploy Hux, Kylo, Phasma, or Snoke to a battleground, may take any one card from Used Pile into hand; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC errata sheet slip (errata_122021.pdf, page 1), PDF dated 21 December 2021<ref name="slip-bow-122021">Players Committee errata sheet [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/errata_122021.pdf#page=1 errata_122021.pdf], page 1 (“Official text as of December 18, 2021”); the date is the PDF's creation date (21 December 2021).</ref> (the sheet says “Official text as of December 18, 2021”). '''What changed:''' “Snoke to a battleground, may” → “Snoke to an [Episode VII] battleground, may”; “one card from Used” → “one card into hand from Used”; “from Used Pile into hand; reshuffle. [Immune” → “from Used Pile; reshuffle. [Immune”; the errata mark “E1” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); a different printing: the errata sheet slip (printed for sleeving over the card) replaces the card image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Debris Zone”. Text: “Deploy on table. Once per game, may take Finalizer into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per character, when you deploy Hux, Kylo, Phasma, or Snoke to an [Episode VII] battleground, may take any one card into hand from Used Pile; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Bow To The First Order (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 21 December 2021<ref name="img-bowtothefirstorder8190af8">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/bowtothefirstorder.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8190af827ca5ef713205ed8648e28428656b00b1 commit 8190af8] (21 December 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Dark/large/bowtothefirstorder.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
